name: LangSmith
description: LangChain's proprietary tracing, evaluation and monitoring platform.
descriptionZh: LangChain 出品的专有追踪、评测与监控平台。
keyFact: LangSmith is LangChain's proprietary platform for tracing, evaluation and monitoring of LLM applications, generally available since February 2024; self-hosting is an Enterprise-only option, and in 2026 it introduced SmithDB, a Rust-based data layer the vendor says delivers a P50 latency of 92ms.
keyFactZh: LangSmith 是 LangChain 的专有平台，用于 LLM 应用的追踪、评测与监控，自 2024 年 2 月 GA；自托管仅限 Enterprise 版，2026 年推出基于 Rust 的数据层 SmithDB，厂商称其 P50 延迟为 92ms。
caveat: Proprietary SaaS; self-hosting is limited to Enterprise agreements. The underlying LangChain/LangGraph SDKs are separately MIT-licensed.
caveatZh: 专有 SaaS；自托管仅限 Enterprise 合约。底层的 LangChain/LangGraph SDK 另为 MIT 许可。
